question: How severe is malicious uprooting compared to an ordinary grave sin?
premises: The act is uprooting done out of hatred.
The comparison is made against a grave sin.
Such an act is said to be greater than a grave sin.
inference: Malicious uprooting exceeds the severity of a grave sin.
uncertainties: The object being uprooted is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Having uprooted something out of hatred, one would incur a fault greater than a grave sin.
